title: Five Café Photos With Music
tests: Produces one finished five-photo reel with the requested sequence, smooth transitions and an audible instrumental soundtrack.

judge.summary: The 10-second vertical reel looks clean and text-free, but the supplied samples do not verify the pastry photo, transition smoothness, or music style.

must_haves.item: One playable vertical reel runs for approximately 10 seconds.
must_haves.why: The supplied MP4 has a reported duration of 10 seconds and portrait-format frames.

must_haves.item: All five supplied café photos appear recognizably in the requested order.
must_haves.why: The samples show storefront, latte, barista, and interior in the expected relative order. The pastry photo could appear between the sampled frames at 3.8 and 6.3 seconds, but its inclusion is not verified.

must_haves.item: Each photo has enough screen time to be recognizable, rather than appearing only as a flash.
must_haves.why: The four sampled photos are recognizable, but isolated frames cannot establish each photo's screen time or the pastry photo's visibility.

must_haves.item: Relaxed instrumental music is audible, with no speech or singing.
must_haves.why: The audio report confirms a non-silent track with no clear speech, but does not establish relaxed instrumental music or rule out singing.

must_haves.item: Transitions between photos are smooth, and no added text appears.
must_haves.why: No added text is visible, but transition smoothness cannot be assessed from the isolated frames.
